summary: W-9 secure-form provenance (Issue #14): vendor_ach_requests gains request_kind ('ach' default, or 'w9_only' for a W-9-only secure link). vendor_documents gains source ('staff_upload' | 'secure_form') and vendor_ach_request_id (FK to the secure-form request, RESTRICT), with a rule that a secure-form document names its request and a unique index so one request can file at most one document. No rows are written; nothing sets w9_on_file, a classification or an exemption.

preflight.name: vendor_ach_requests has no request_kind column yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'vendor_ach_requests' AND column_name = 'request_kind'

preflight.name: vendor_documents has no source / vendor_ach_request_id columns yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'vendor_documents' AND column_name IN ('source', 'vendor_ach_request_id')

expected_changes: Adds vendor_ach_requests.request_kind (NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ach') with CHECK vendor_ach_requests_request_kind_check ('ach' | 'w9_only'). Existing requests read 'ach'.
Adds vendor_documents.source (nullable) with CHECK vendor_documents_source_check ('staff_upload' | 'secure_form'). Existing documents keep NULL.
Adds vendor_documents.vendor_ach_request_id (nullable, FK vendor_ach_requests, ON DELETE RESTRICT) and CHECK vendor_documents_secure_form_provenance (a 'secure_form' document must name its request).
Creates unique partial index uq_vendor_documents_ach_request (one document per secure-form request).

verify.name: every existing request reads 'ach'
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM vendor_ach_requests WHERE request_kind <> 'ach'

verify.name: no existing document was given a source or request link
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM vendor_documents WHERE source IS NOT NULL OR vendor_ach_request_id IS NOT NULL

verify.name: one-document-per-request index present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname = 'uq_vendor_documents_ach_request'
